div.div: هُرْدٌ Certain roots with which one dyes, (L, K,) of a yellow colour: (TA:) or (so accord. to the L; but in the K, and) i. q. كُرْكُمٌ: (L, K:) or the yellow كُرْكُم: correctly, the roots of the كُرْكُم, or وَرْس: (TA:) and a certain red earth (K) with which one dyes. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
